youtube.title: Short Vowels for Kids! CVC Words on Vowel Island | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Robo, Frog and Duck find the missing vowels on Vowel Island! Learn the short sounds of a, e, i, o and u, blend three sounds into words like cat, hen and pig, and watch the Vowel Swap Machine turn bag into beg, big, bog and bug.
For first graders learning to read: short vowels, CVC words and blending. Say the sounds out loud with Robo!

do.text: Look! Something is floating to our island.
Quack! A bottle with a note inside!
The note says: C, gap, T. H, gap, T. P, gap, G.
And look at our island sign. It has gaps too!
Can you help us find the missing vowels?
Five little huts, one for each vowel.
The vowels are a, e, i, o and u.
Short a, like in apple. Bite the apple!
Short e, like in egg. Crack the egg!
Fun fact: e is the most used letter in English!
Short i, like in. The ball goes in!
Short o, like on. The ball sits on!
Short u, like up. The balloon goes up!
Our sign is fixed! Vowel Island!
Say the short sounds with me!
Every short word has a vowel in the middle.
Let's sound it out. Tap, tap, tap, then slide.
Hen! A hen is a grown-up girl chicken.
P, i, g. That's me! I'm a pig!
Dog! The o is in the middle.
Bug! The u is in the middle.
Change the middle vowel to make a new word. Cat!
In goes a, out comes o. Cot!
Now hat. Watch it change three times!
My turn. I want to make pig.
Oh no, that says peg! Which vowel do I need?
Yes, i! Now it says pig!
Now the big finale. One word, five vowels!
A bog! That's a muddy place where frogs live!
Fun fact: a bog is soft, wet, muddy land.
Bag, beg, big, bog, bug. Five real words!
Middle sound, bounce! a, e, i, o, u!
Frog, let's go on a word hunt!
Okay! But first, can I live in a hut?
The three-letter hut! F, r, o, g!
Sorry, Frog. Frog has four letters!
Hmm. Then I'll hunt for words!
Listen: map. Which vowel is in map?
a! Map has a in the middle.
Listen: web. Which vowel is in web?
e! Web has e in the middle.
Listen: lid. Which vowel is in lid?
i! Lid has i in the middle.
Listen: mop. Which vowel is in mop?
o! Mop has o in the middle.
Listen: sun. Which vowel is in sun?
u! Sun has u in the middle.
Five words, five vowels! I'm a word hunter!
Island quiz time! Shout your answer after the click.
Question one. Which vowel is in sun?
u! Sun has u in the middle.
Question two. Change the a in map to o.
Question three. Which word has a short e?
Hen! Hen has a short e.
Question four. Bug is b, gap, g. Which vowel fills the gap?
Last one. Blend these sounds. What word?
Lid! Like the lid on a box.
Five out of five! You are vowel experts!
All five vowels are home. Vowel Island!
And Frog, I found a word for you.
Take the r out of frog. Fog!
F, o, g. Three letters, with short o!
Fog! I'm on the hut! Thank you, Robo!
Five vowels, and the middle one changes the word.
